tenderSchedule.description: Maintanance work of Halebeedu-Annechakur Road (HHAPC) SH-21 from ch 0.00 to 9.20 Km for the year 2026-27 in Belur Taluk

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder send

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for these costs
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all the Tenders without assigning any reasons
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-Procurement Portal
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders

As per Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 1.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner other wise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the original documents before approval
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class IV and above Registration
To qualify for award of this contract, each tender should give all details and documents as per K.W-1 and Work should be carried out as per K/W-1 STD attached with tender
The period of completion for work is 3 Months & the eligible contractor should maintain the Road Pot Hole free for ONE YEAR from the date of issue of Work order
Contractor shall bound to comply the prevailing rules and regulations with regard to the EPF Contribution rules and any modifications there of before and after execution of agreement
The FSD & Unbalanced Amount payable at the time of executing agreement, will be refunded only after successful completion of Defect Liability Period i.e., One Year from date of issue of work order
Contractors has to submit their labour EPF details with every Running Bill

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per govt Circular No:FD 417 Exp-12/2024, Banglore Dtd:09.08.2024 and prevailing GST (18% of amount put to tender) amount is kept in form of Lumpsum in sanctioned estimate. Therefore amount put to tender and ECV amount are excluding GST. But the itemwise rates do not include GST. Hence GST will be paid separately for the Executed amount accordingly.
The GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The Government and the Contractor have to abide to any increase or decrease in GST during agreement period
Contractors has to upload the E P F Registration Certificate
Contractor Shall comply with the Environment Protection Act 1986 and the Rules made there under
Contractors are responsible for ensuring Safety and also whole & Sole responsibility for any injury or risk factors of workers

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and compete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured according to ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS ISO 14001:2015) & QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (QMS ISO 9001:2015) Policies, so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to the existing public/ private properties which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.

Contractor should adhere to HSE (Health Safety Environment) policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.
Successful bidder has to furnish 0.1% of award contract amount as insurance during entering in to agreement.
The contractor belonging to Scheduled Caste should upload Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority of Government of Karnataka
If the contractor is a firm, then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the Scheduled Caste as the case may be
The contractor belonging to Scheduled Caste shall be domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years (Should upload Certificate issued by Competent Authority).

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: KPWD Class-IV and above Registration Certificate
The contractor belonging to Scheduled Caste should upload Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority of Government of Karnataka
Contractors has to upload the EPF Registration Certificate

Tenderers will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. i.e. A x N x 5.00 - B i.e, Rs.11.02 Lakhs as per KW-1 Document. The Bidder must submit the Annual Turnover Certificate issued by Approved Chartered Accountant with UDIN and profit and loss statement or workdone Certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer for computing the value of A and B for the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 Updated to 2026-27 price level
The contractor belonging to Scheduled Caste shall be domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years,Should upload Certificate issued by Competent Authority

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Maintanance work of Halebeedu-Annechakur Road (HHAPC) SH-21 from ch 0.00 to 9.20 Km for the year 2026-27 in Belur Taluk

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Surface Drains in Soil - Construction  of    unlined  surface  drains  of  average  cross- sectional  area  0.40  m2  in  soil  to  specified  lines,  grades, levels  and  dimensions.  Excavated  material  to  be  used  in embankment with a lift upto 3m and lead of 50 m (average lead 25 m) as per Technical Specification Clause 307. - Mechanical Means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 307 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Printing  letters  and  figures  of  any  shade  with  synthtic enamel  paint  of  any  approved  colour  to  give  an  even shade. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Road Signs - Maintenance of road signs by way of cleaning and repainting of   mandatory   /   requlatory   /   cautionary   /   informatory and  place  identifications  sign  board  as  perdrawings  and technical specification. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1911 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Scarifying  Existing  Granular  Surface  to  a  Depth  of  50  mm  by Mechanical Means using Hydraulic excavator. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.4.3 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with type B Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- With all lead and lift including cost and conveyance of all materials,labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all other incidental charges etc.,complete as per standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer-in-charge of work.
